items.title: Train deploy target train.service@alpha refused: missing env PG_TOKEN_FILE
items.description:
Why: the train deploy preflight refused train.service@alpha of part(s) #1: missing env PG_TOKEN_FILE.
How: fix the host or the Deploy-Hosts/Deploy declaration, rerun the dry run.
Done when: the dry run passes for this target.
items.done_criteria: The host install dry run passes for train.service@alpha.
